title: 創辦人
description: 出於對捕夢網手工藝的熱愛創立 Tela Aurea Lab，理解捕夢網走線數學規則後，開發網頁捕夢網設計工具，未來計畫無償提供給北美原住民的文化教育機構使用，希望能協助保存文化遺產。歡迎體驗互動式網站入口 每日一網 (Daily Dose)
description_eng: Driven by a passion for dreamcatcher craftsmanship, Tela Aurea Lab was founded. After understanding the mathematical rules governing dreamcatcher weaving, a web-based dreamcatcher design tool was developed. The plan is to provide this tool free of charge to Native American cultural and educational institutions in North America, hoping to help preserve cultural heritage. Welcome to experience the interactive website: Daily Dose.
